capabilities: Create and edit kanban boards stored as one Markdown file per board
Drag and drop cards and reorder columns
Track due dates, recurring tasks, tags, custom fields, and checklists per card
Import and export boards as CSV or Trello-compatible JSON
Embed live boards in notes and Canvas with edits writing back to the board file
extras: Manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; README documents the board Markdown file format in detail, including reserved metadata keys.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to manage tasks on a visual Trello-style kanban board whose data stays in plain, diff-safe Markdown files.

relations.evidence: Import/Export as CSV (full metadata) and as Trello‑compatible JSON (lists, labels, checklists, due dates, custom fields)

summary: Markdown-backed kanban board with drag-and-drop columns, due dates, recurring tasks, card templates, WIP limits, and embeddable live boards.
